name: University of Southern California
description: The University of Southern California is a private research university in Los Angeles, California, founded in 1880. It is known for engineering, business, film and communication.
whyIncluded: The University of Southern California is among the 10 universities in the United States most chosen by international students (17,884 international students in 2024-25, per IIE Open Doors), per the FinexisEdu shortlist research of October 2026.

livingCosts.summary: USC's own budget for an undergraduate living on campus for two semesters: housing, food, transport, books and personal costs. Excludes tuition and fees.
livingCosts.notes: 2026-27 undergraduate cost of attendance, living on campus, two semesters: housing $13,510; food $8,442; transportation $1,188; books and supplies $670 + personal and miscellaneous $2,016 = personal. Two semesters taken as 9 months (the page does not state months).

programmes.name: Mechanical Engineering (BS)
programmes.summary: Yearly tuition for USC undergraduates, the same for all majors and for international students, plus mandatory fees and a one-time new student fee. Rises most years; health insurance not included.
programmes.notes: USC Financial Aid cost of attendance, 2026-27 undergraduate: tuition (12-18 units for two semesters) $75,384, fees $1,952, plus a $450 new student fee in the first semester (one-off). 2025-26 on the same page: tuition $73,260, fees $1,902 (new student fee for that year not shown, so current one-off used). The page does not itemise 'fees'; no health insurance line is included. Flat-rate tuition, same for all majors. Not cohort-locked. 2024-25 not found. Viterbi School of Engineering.

programmes.name: MS in Mechanical Engineering
programmes.summary: Yearly tuition for an international Viterbi master's student taking 9 units a semester (charged per unit), plus mandatory fees and a one-time orientation fee. Health insurance not included.
programmes.notes: USC Viterbi 2026-27 cost-of-attendance sheet (33-unit master's): graduate engineering tuition $2,742 per unit; the sheet assumes 9 units in each of the first two semesters, so annual = 18 x $2,742 = $49,356. Other fees = mandatory fees $922 per semester x2 (student health service, programming, transportation, Topping Student Aid Fund); one-off = $55 orientation fee. Health insurance (2025-26 rates $1,224 fall, $2,298 spring/summer) excluded. 2025 history from the 2025-26 sheet: $2,665 per unit x 18 = $47,970; fees $897 per semester x2 = $1,794; orientation $55. All Viterbi master's programmes are charged the same per-unit rate; total cost depends on the programme's unit count (27-33 units, typically four semesters). Not cohort-locked.
